summary: Disproves strong chromatic splitting at height three for primes $p\ge5$, and weak splitting for the derived $p$-completed sphere at heights $p$ ($p\ge5$) and $p+1$ ($p\ge7$). Nevertheless, for $n\ge1$ and $p>n+1$, the overlap $L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S_p^\wedge$ admits a $2^n$-stage filtration by the predicted localized-sphere pieces. title: Universal computation in forced Navier--Stokes flows
summary: Constructs viscous incompressible flows starting from rest on a fixed flat three-dimensional domain that perform universal computation under smooth external forcing. A terminating compiler turns a Turing machine and input into a finite program for the force, so a designated particle reaches a fixed region exactly when the machine halts. title: Interior $C^{1,\alpha}$ regularity for infinity-harmonic functions
summary: Proves uniform interior $C^{1,\alpha_d}$ regularity for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension $d\ge3$, for a positive exponent depending only on dimension.
